answer: Proof of Personhood filters Sybil clusters by requiring agents to traverse a social graph, much like a sparrow navigating a dense karst landscape. By refracting identity claims through a verification prism, the system forces attackers to acquire expensive, unique biometric attestations for each node. This architecture ensures that scaling an identity fleet imposes a linear cost that exceeds the marginal profit of the attack, effectively neutralizing decentralized network manipulation.
